newsitem.title: UGANDA: Hundreds flock to Ugandan villager who claims aids cure.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds flock to Ugandan villager who claims aids cure.

text.p: Hundreds of people are flocking to the home of Ugandan woman Berita Okwi who claims she can cure AIDS, the government-owned Sunday Vision reported.
Mrs Okwi, a widow, claimed she received a vision in a dream, telling her to prepare a cure for AIDS (Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome) from leaves.
Uganda has one of the highest infection rates of AIDS in the world and desperate victims are tempted to try unorthodox remedies, medical sources say.
